text:
sam: Quick thread to capture design decisions from today's dedicated-capacity breakout. Topic: ephemeral preemption credits, lease phasing, and ledger reconciliation.

nina: Recap: customers want predictable burst behavior but don't want to overcommit. We sketched a model: baseline reserved vCPUs/GPUs, purchasable ephemeral credits (burned per-second), and a short-term lease window for fast spikes.

ashley: Key product constraints: credits must be debitable atomically; leases should auto-expire after N minutes to avoid long tail resource hold. Also need clear UI language for 'fast spike' vs 'sustained burst'.

sam: Runtime note: we'll implement a lease TTL + heartbeat. If heartbeat misses, lease returns to pool and credits are reconciled. Ledger will track debits and pending holds.

nina: Launch criteria proposal:
- API: POST /pools/:id/credits/debit, GET /pools/:id/credits/status
- Console: real-time credit meter + per-tenant recent lease list
- Metrics: pool_credit_hold_seconds, credit_debits_total, lease_expiry_events
- Pilot: 2 customers (1 with strict SLA, 1 with wallet-only), 2-week run

ashley: Billing ask: Finance wants deterministic rounding rules (credits billed per-second, minimum 30s granularity) and a monthly reconciliation run that emits CSV.

finance: Flag: include an overage policy for customers who exceed purchased credits unintentionally. Either auto-topup with admin approval or throttle. Need product decision.

sam: Eviction priority we agreed on: (1) opportunistic (no credits), (2) ephemeral-credit holders (soft), (3) lease-reserved (hard). Within same tier, use commit-level then created_at timestamp as tiebreaker.

nina: Reconciler design note: background job runs every 1m to find stale leases, reconcile ledger discrepancies, and emit alerts if debit vs usage delta > 0.5% for last 24h. Reconciler will write to `reconciler.log` and create REDW ticket on anomalies.

devops-bot: Ticket created: https://redwood.atlassian.net/browse/REDW-812 - Ledger reconciler + metrics

ashley: Risks: cross-tenant credit leaks during host failover; delayed ledger commits causing temporary overspend; customer confusion on rounding. Mitigations: host-level rollback on failover, strong idempotent debit API, and clear FAQ.

finance: Also request sample invoice lines for pilot customers to validate parser.

sam: Next steps: Nina -> wireframe credit meter & lease UX; Ashley -> finalize overage policy choice; Sam -> start RFC for TTL/heartbeat + reconciler; Finance -> prepare invoice examples. Sync Mon 9am.
